title: Empowering Women through AI
summary: The AI4IA conference archive highlights the importance of empowering women through digital technologies and AI. Initiatives such as Itrade for Women aim to harness the transformative power of digital technologies to drive inclusive growth and innovation. However, there is still more work to be done to ensure that AI is accessible to all, particularly in emerging markets.
